versions.localizedDescription:
Orivyn 0.1.3 build 19 — unfinished unsigned iOS 26+ preview.

Changes: normal code-drafting answers are separated from tool decisions; relevant conversation context is retained without repeating failed/current turns. Supported explicit calculator/memory/app-info requests require recorded reads. App-info statuses and omissions are rendered from the exact receipt rather than relabeled by a model. Tokenizer fitting preserves the current request and recorded results, with explicit overflow failure and no replay. Improved reasoning-marker filtering preserves Markdown code. No video downloading, broader autonomy, vision or sync is added.

Verification: exact-source iPhone 16 Plus / iOS 26.1 Simulator gate passed all 245 selected tests with zero failures/skips. Actual pinned Qwen3-1.7B tests produced Python code for fresh, refusal-polluted and long-history requests, preserved an Explain follow-up topic, correctly reported calculator and unpredictable saved-memory results with receipts, and retained exact app-info statuses/omissions. Separate actual-tokenizer overflow stress rejected oversized goal/evidence without replay. Combined runtime verification and Release device compilation/IPA structure checks passed on the same source. Packaging SCOPE says native tests not_run for that separate packaging step; the preceding simulator step ran independently. These are scoped fixtures, not general model parity or physical-device acceptance.

Limits remain: the user's full private backup and its attachment associations have not been accepted end to end. Unsupported data must remain explicitly reported; synthetic ZIP tests do not establish every exported asset can be restored. This is not general ChatGPT parity or unrestricted autonomous execution. Plugin suggestions do not execute automatically. Physical iPhone installation, signing refresh, thermal/resource behavior, voice and broad app acceptance remain unverified. Some broader vision and live-sync capabilities remain unfinished. Models download separately; no weights are bundled. Optional remote providers may charge.

Preserve existing app data and signing identity when updating. SideStore or another compatible installer must sign this unsigned IPA. Earlier builds remain available. Not completed 1.0.0 and not an OpenAI product.

A narrowly scoped oracle correction with eight negative controls was independently reviewed, then the full 216-test gate passed; production enforcement and prompts were unchanged. These are scoped checks, not generalized conversational or physical-device acceptance.

Physical iPhone installation, signing, full private-backup/media mapping and broader device acceptance remain unverified. Existing imported data is not automatically rewritten. Preserve app data and signing identity when updating. Models download separately; optional remote providers may charge. Prior releases remain available. Not completed 1.0.0 or an OpenAI product.

Orivyn 0.1.1 build 12 — unfinished unsigned iOS 26+ preview.

Adds conservative recovery of orphaned private model snapshots on the next native model load that creates a new private snapshot. A process-lifetime lease protects active snapshots, and the loader keeps that lease until native context/model teardown. Cleanup only touches recognized app-owned versioned directories with matching ownership metadata and expected files. Installed model downloads, unmarked legacy directories, active copies, symlinks, hardlinks and directories with unexpected contents are preserved. Cleanup is bounded to 128 candidates per pass with a rotating cursor; directory enumeration itself is not bounded.

The earlier backup-replacement confirmation change is retained. Preserve-local remains the default. Existing native tools, experimental vision and transcript features remain enabled.

Verification scope: 10 host-native filesystem tests passed with zero failures or skips; synthetic process-lifetime checks passed; Release iOS device compilation and unsigned IPA structure/resource verification. These are not actual iPhone inference, memory-mapped model lifetime or device acceptance tests. Physical-iPhone behavior, selected-file confirmation UI and external file-provider grants remain unverified.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take a photo to attach and recognize its text on this iPhone.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Only when you connect to your chosen plugin server, Orivyn may access that server on your local network. Chats and files are not sent automatically.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Only when you tap Get current location, Orivyn asks iOS for a one-time location displayed on this screen. It is not sent to a model or server.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Orivyn uses the microphone only when you start dictation or a voice conversation.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Orivyn transcribes your speech on this iPhone when you start dictation or voice conversation.
